metadata.title: Neon Breach: Data Heist
metadata.description: Fast-paced cyberpunk arena survival with data collection objectives.

metadata.title: Neon Breach: Drone Protocol
metadata.description: Survive 3 waves of neon drones in a high-speed arena.

design_spec.title: Neon Breach: Drone Protocol
design_spec.elevator_pitch: A high-octane top-down survival arena where you fight off escalating waves of security drones using rapid-fire weaponry and tactical dashes.
secondary_objectives: Collect energy cells to restore health
Maximize score by eliminating drones quickly
rationale: Top-down perspective allows for 360-degree kiting, essential for survival against swarms
Dash mechanic provides high-mobility evasion to offset the high physics complexity and enemy speed
Escalating enemy behaviors (Patrol -> Chase -> Ranged) ensure a steady difficulty curve

loop_details.player_action: Kite enemies and use ranged attacks to clear the arena
loop_details.immediate_feedback: Screen shake on dash and particle bursts on enemy defeat
loop_details.increasing_pressure: Enemy speed and attack patterns evolve each wave
loop_details.progression: Wave counter increments upon clearing all active enemies
loop_details.resolution: Victory screen triggered after the 3rd wave is defeated

progression_phases.description: Introductory combat with slow patrolling drones

metadata.title: Neon Protocol: Data Extraction
metadata.description: Infiltrate the neon core and extract the data.

design_spec.title: Neon Protocol: Data Extraction
design_spec.elevator_pitch: A high-stakes cyberpunk data courier must infiltrate neon-lit sectors to retrieve encrypted chips while evading relentless hunter-drones in a high-speed arcade challenge.
design_spec.primary_objective: Collect encrypted data chips and neutralize security drones to reach the required decryption score for each sector.
secondary_objectives: Use dash to evade hunter drones
Defeat the Core Sentry for a massive score boost
win_conditions: Reach the target score in each sector to progress, culminating in the final data extraction at the Core.
rationale: Top-down perspective facilitates the atmospheric exploration of a cyberpunk city while maintaining arcade clarity.
High-speed dash mechanics provide responsive controls for tight evasion in dense neon corridors.
Cumulative score-based progression ensures players engage with both collection and combat mechanics to advance.

loop_details.player_action: Navigate complex neon corridors using dash for mobility and pulse shots for defense.
loop_details.immediate_feedback: Visual screen shake on damage, particle trails during dash, and neon glow pulses on collection.
loop_details.increasing_pressure: Enemy density and pursuit speed increase as more data chips are collected.
loop_details.progression: Move from low-security outskirts to the high-security Core sector.
loop_details.resolution: Successful extraction of the final data payload.

objective_details.primary: Collect all data chips while evading hunter drones

progression_phases.description: Sector Alpha: Basic patrol evasion and chip collection.
progression_phases.runtime_effect: Low enemy count, slow patrol speeds.

progression_phases.description: Sector Beta: Introduction of aggressive hunter drones and laser hazards.
progression_phases.runtime_effect: Increased enemy speed and chase logic.

progression_phases.description: The Core: High-density security with a central Sentry Boss.
progression_phases.runtime_effect: Maximum threat density and ranged attacks.

metadata.title: Neon Drift: Data Runner
metadata.description: Cyberpunk courier sandbox with high-speed chases.

design_spec.title: Neon Drift: Data Runner
design_spec.elevator_pitch: A high-octane cyberpunk courier simulation where you navigate a neon-soaked metropolis, delivering illicit data while evading corporate security forces in a high-stakes open-world sandbox.
design_spec.core_gameplay_loop: accept mission -> navigate districts -> evade security -> deliver data -> upgrade reputation
design_spec.primary_objective: Complete high-priority data deliveries across interconnected city districts.
secondary_objectives: Hack data vaults for bonus credits
Lower threat levels at safehouse terminals
loss_conditions: Threat level reaches maximum during critical mission
rationale: Top-down perspective facilitates complex navigation through city streets and alleyways.
The open-world system allows for non-linear exploration and emergent chase sequences.
High-speed dash and vehicle mechanics emphasize the 'courier' fantasy of speed and agility.

loop_details.player_action: Drive hovercraft through neon streets to reach delivery waypoints.
loop_details.immediate_feedback: Neon trails behind vehicle, screen shake on collisions, and credit gain UI popups.
loop_details.increasing_pressure: Threat level rises with each delivery, spawning faster and more aggressive security drones.
loop_details.progression: Unlock access to the Corporate Plaza and Industrial districts by completing missions in The Slums.
loop_details.resolution: Deliver the final 'God-Chip' to the Fixer to secure your freedom.

objective_details.primary: Deliver encrypted data chips to designated drop-points.

progression_phases.runtime_effect: Only Patrol Drones active; low threat decay.
Interceptors spawn; threat level increases faster.

progression_phases.description: The Great Extraction from the High-Rise District.
progression_phases.runtime_effect: Heavy Enforcers and Boss Overseer active.

levels.title: The First Run
levels.description: Deliver the basic chips to the Slums drop-points.

levels.title: Heat Rising
levels.description: Navigate the plaza while CorpSec interceptors hunt you.

levels.title: The Grand Extraction
levels.description: Defeat the CorpSec Overseer and secure the final data core.

metadata.title: Neon Syndicate: Data Breach
metadata.description: Cyberpunk top-down shooter with dash mechanics.

design_spec.title: Neon Syndicate: Data Breach
design_spec.elevator_pitch: A high-octane top-down shooter where you infiltrate neon-drenched corporate towers to extract encrypted data while fighting off waves of security drones.
design_spec.primary_objective: Eliminate security forces and collect data cores.
rationale: Increased entity counts per level to meet standard scale tier requirements and enhance tactical depth.
Strategic placement of obstacles provides cover, balancing the high-speed dash and projectile combat.
The neon aesthetic reinforces the cyberpunk theme while providing high-contrast visual clarity for gameplay elements.

loop_details.player_action: Engage enemies with ranged attacks and dash through hazards to collect data chips.
loop_details.immediate_feedback: Screen shake on hits, particle bursts on enemy defeat, and UI score increments.
loop_details.increasing_pressure: Enemy density and aggression increase as more data chips are collected.
loop_details.progression: Unlock new sectors (levels) with higher threat levels and complex hazard layouts.
loop_details.resolution: Defeat the Mainframe Sentry in the final level to secure the data breach.

objective_details.primary: Collect all data chips and eliminate the boss sentry.

progression_phases.runtime_effect: Hunter units and laser hazards introduced.
Heavy Sentry boss and high-speed chase units.

metadata.title: Void Sector: Star-Runner
metadata.description: Survive the void in this open-world space shooter.

design_spec.title: Void Sector: Star-Runner
design_spec.elevator_pitch: A high-octane space shooter set in a persistent open-world nebula where pilots must scavenge energy cores and survive escalating pirate raids.
design_spec.primary_objective: Eliminate sector threats and secure energy cores for the jump gate.
rationale: Top-down perspective allows for 360-degree combat and better spatial awareness in the open-world nebula.
Zero-gravity physics with high acceleration mimics the feel of space flight while maintaining arcade responsiveness.
The dash mechanic serves as both a defensive dodge and a traversal tool for navigating dense asteroid fields.

loop_details.player_action: Pilot the starship through asteroid fields, engaging hostile factions with blasters and tactical dashes.
loop_details.immediate_feedback: Screen shakes on impact, particle trails on dash, and satisfying explosions on enemy defeat.
loop_details.increasing_pressure: Alert levels rise as more enemies are defeated, triggering faster and more aggressive interceptors.
loop_details.progression: Unlock new sectors by gathering energy cores and increasing reputation with the Star-Guard faction.
loop_details.resolution: Defeat the sector boss to stabilize the jump gate and escape the nebula.

objective_details.primary: Collect Energy Cores per sector to power the gate.

progression_phases.description: Introduction to flight and basic combat against stationary and patrolling drones.
Escalation of threat with chasing interceptors and hazardous asteroid belts.
The Void Sovereign boss battle with high-density projectile fire.

activities.title: Supply Run
activities.description: Transport essential supplies across districts to the secure terminal.

activities.title: Sector Recon
activities.description: Investigate anomalous energy signatures in the outer zone.
